Singer and actor has denied all charges after more than 20 women came forward with allegations going back to the 1990s The French singer Patrick Bruel has been charged with rape and sexual assault in one of the biggest #MeToo cases in the French music industry. The 67-year-old, a major figure in French pop culture, was placed under formal investigation over several cases that included alleged rape, attempted rape, sexual assault and sexual harassment.

The Nanterre prosecutor’s office said Bruel had been questioned on Wednesday over cases relating to nine alleged victims between 2000 and 2019. Complaints from another 13 women accusing him of rape, attempted rape, sexual assault and sexual harassment from 1992 to 2008 had been added to the file handed to investigating magistrates, even if they “appeared to be beyond the statute of limitations at this stage”, the office said. Bruel’s lawyers said he denied all charges. The singer was released on bail in the early hours of Thursday.

Bruel, whose lawyers told Mediapart, he denied “all allegations of violence, brutality or constraint” had continued acting on stage in a Paris until recent days and had intended to continue his concert tour across France. But he faced protests by feminist campaigners, and the mayors of big cities such as Marseille, Paris and Nancy urged him to cancel his concerts, resulting in him calling off the tour. Bruel attended a police station by appointment earlier this week and was charged on Wednesday night after hours of questioning by judges. The women who spoke out against Bruel in recent months include Daniela Elstner, the current director of Unifrance, a key cultural institution which promotes French cinema abroad.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: The Guardian World]
Singer and actor has denied all charges after more than 20 women came forward with allegations going back to the 1990s

The French singer Patrick Bruel has been charged with rape and sexual assault in one of the biggest #MeToo cases in the French music industry.

The 67-year-old, a major figure in French pop culture, was placed under formal investigation over several cases that included alleged rape, attempted rape, sexual assault and sexual harassment.

The Nanterre prosecutor’s office said Bruel had been questioned on Wednesday over cases relating to nine alleged victims between 2000 and 2019. Complaints from another 13 women accusing him of rape, attempted rape, sexual assault and sexual harassment from 1992 to 2008 had been added to the file handed to investigating magistrates, even if they “appeared to be beyond the statute of limitations at this stage”, the office said.

Bruel’s lawyers said he denied all charges. The singer was released on bail in the early hours of Thursday.

Bruel’s pop career took off in the 1990s with several top-selling albums. His face was routinely on the cover of teen magazines and his screaming fans were described as being in thrall to “bruelmania”. At the height of his fame, French media often described him admiringly as a “seducer” or “Don Juan”. He acted in dozens of films and in 1998 was briefly a world poker champion and continued to to be a regular on TV chat shows.

The investigative website Mediapart and the magazine Elle published a series of accusations by women against Bruel in recent months, some detailing alleged assaults dating back to the 1990s.

Bruel, whose lawyers told Mediapart, he denied “all allegations of violence, brutality or constraint” had continued acting on stage in a Paris until recent days and had intended to continue his concert tour across France. But he faced protests by feminist campaigners, and the mayors of big cities such as Marseille, Paris and Nancy urged him to cancel his concerts, resulting in him calling off the tour.

Bruel attended a police station by appointment earlier this week and was charged on Wednesday night after hours of questioning by judges.

The women who spoke out against Bruel in recent months include Daniela Elstner, the current director of Unifrance, a key cultural institution which promotes French cinema abroad.

payload.title: Patrick Bruel asetettiin rikostutkintaan raiskaus- ja seksuaalirikosepäilyistä
payload.summary: Ranskalainen laulaja ja näyttelijä Patrick Bruel on asetettu viralliseen rikostutkintaan useista raiskaus- ja seksuaalirikosepäilyistä. Bruel kiistää asianajajiensa mukaan kaikki häntä vastaan esitetyt syytökset.
payload.content:
Ranskalainen laulaja ja näyttelijä Patrick Bruel on asetettu Ranskassa viralliseen rikostutkintaan useista vakavista seksuaalirikosepäilyistä, jotka koskevat väitettyjä uhreja ja tapahtumia vuosilta 1992–2019. Bruel, 67, on ranskalaisen populaarikulttuurin tunnettu nimi, ja hänen asianajajiensa mukaan hän kiistää kaikki häntä vastaan esitetyt syytökset.

## Epäilyt ulottuvat useille vuosikymmenille

Nanterren syyttäjänviraston mukaan Bruelia kuulusteltiin keskiviikkona tapauksista, jotka liittyvät yhdeksään väitettyyn uhriin vuosien 2000 ja 2019 välillä. Tutkinnan piiriin on lisäksi liitetty 13 muun naisen valitukset, joissa Bruelia syytetään raiskauksesta, raiskauksen yrityksestä, seksuaalisesta väkivallasta ja seksuaalisesta häirinnästä vuosilta 1992–2008.

Syyttäjänviraston mukaan osa vanhemmista epäilyistä näyttää tässä vaiheessa olevan rikosoikeudellisten määräaikojen ulkopuolella. Ne on silti lisätty tutkintatuomareille toimitettuun aineistoon. Bruel vapautettiin takuita vastaan varhain torstaina.

Tapausta on kuvattu yhdeksi Ranskan musiikkialan merkittävimmistä #MeToo-tapauksista, koska julkisuuteen on tullut yli 20 naisen väitteitä, jotka ulottuvat 1990-luvulle. Bruelin asianajajat kertoivat Mediapartille, että hän kiistää kaikki väitteet väkivallasta, raakuudesta tai pakottamisesta.

## Kiertue peruuntui paineen kasvaessa

Bruel oli esiintynyt Pariisissa vielä viime päiviin asti ja oli aikonut jatkaa konserttikiertuettaan eri puolilla Ranskaa. Tilanne muuttui, kun feministiset kampanjoijat protestoivat häntä vastaan ja useiden suurten kaupunkien, kuten Marseillen, Pariisin ja Nancyn, pormestarit kehottivat häntä perumaan konsertit.

Paineen seurauksena Bruel perui kiertueensa. Hän saapui poliisiasemalle sovitusti aiemmin tällä viikolla ja hänet asetettiin rikostutkintaan keskiviikkoiltana tuntikausia kestäneiden tuomarikuulustelujen jälkeen.

Viime kuukausina Bruelia vastaan puhuneiden naisten joukossa on Daniela Elstner, joka johtaa Unifrancea. Kyseessä on keskeinen kulttuuri-instituutio, joka edistää ranskalaista elokuvaa ulkomailla.
